description: This file defines functionality for deleting comments within a Conduit application, including a command, validation, and a request handler that interacts with the database context to remove a comment by its ID and associated article slug.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents the data required to delete a comment, including article slug and comment ID.

classes.name: CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the delete command to ensure the slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the delete comment request by locating the article and comment, then removing the comment from the database.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the deletion process for a comment, throwing exceptions if the article or comment isn't found, and saving changes to the database.
